$comment: Pinned source for every generated Forever record. Change the build only in a reviewed PR. Build seen on wago.tools in public Forever projects (alcaras/forever-ref, rdimascio/wow-ai PR 28). Confirm with: node build-forever-db.mjs --list-builds
$comment_prereqRankBase: Whether Talent.PrereqRank is 0-based or 1-based. Left null: the importer proves it from the data (a 0 value means 0-based, a value equal to the required talent's max rank means 1-based) and records the proof in manifest.json. If set, the data must agree or the build stops.
